Can AI create music, or is it simply remixing what already exists? Jeff Crume explores how artificial intelligence is changing music creation, from composition and lyric writing to performance, production, and collaboration. Learn how AI-generated music works, what it means for musicians, and why the future of music may be less about replacement and more about creative partnership.
